name: smwpatches-easy-to-see-shaking-shell
title: Easy-to-see Shaking Shell
description:
If the resurrection of Koopa Troopa or Buzzy Beetle is approaching, we highlight and display the shaking of the shell.
Combination with the SMB3 Koopa Patch is also possible.
At Special World, even if the shell is the face of Mario, it shakes properly.
You can set the presence or absence of the eye display of the Koopa Troopa that Stun timer is operating.
